G=load()
for n in (1,2,3):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(f'=== demo {n}')
    foursI=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    foursO=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(O) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    twos=[i for i,r in enumerate(I) if 2 in r]
    above=[r for r in range(min(twos))]
    # check: does output preserve the originals + add new?
    print('orig in out:', all((p in foursI) or (p not in foursI and True) for p in []))
    # find added positions
    add=[p for p in foursO if p not in foursI]; rem=[p for p in foursI if p not in foursO]
    print('added:',add,'removed:',rem)
    print('new rows with 4:',sorted({p[0] for p in add}))

G=load()
def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    line=[i for i,r in enumerate(I) if 2 in r][0]
    fours=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    P=[(i+1,j) for i,j in fours]   # all shift down 1
    above=[p for p in P if p[0]<line]
    anchor=max(above,key=lambda p: p[0])  # closest to line
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(line+1): out[i]=[2]*W
    for i,j in P: out[i][j]=4
    d0=anchor[1]-anchor[0]; d1=anchor[0]+anchor[1]
    for k in range(anchor[0]):
        if 0<=anchor[1]-k<W: out[k][anchor[1]-k]=4
        if 0<=anchor[1]+k<W: out[k][anchor[1]+k]=4
    return out
for n in (1,2,3):

import itertools,json
def simulate(inp, variant):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    div=[r for r in range(H) if all(inp[r][c]==2 for c in range(W))]
    drow=div[0]
    shifted=[(r+1,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==4 and r!=drow]
